qualityGate.reason: The Playwright test is syntactically correct and uses the API properly, ensuring that the product detail page loads and a product name is visible. However, the navigation validation regex is weak as it broadly matches any URL containing 'product', which may lead to false positives, and the selectors use data-test attributes which seem specific but there is no testCaseId link in the test title. The test lacks coverage for other product details and more robust assertion of page content.
